subHeadline: The verdicts people actually want before they read a single spec sheet - the calls we'd make for a friend, backed by real UK enquiry and failure data.

light.alt: White BMW front for ownership rankings

dark.alt: BMW front in a dark garage

rankings.why: Modern straight-six with well-understood, repairable failure points - coolant leaks aside, largely trouble-free. Just 540 enquiries in 2025, mostly due-diligence, not failure [BMW-VERIFIED].
B47/B48/B58 engines in the lightest chassis - 190 enquiries in 2025, predominantly pre-purchase research [BMW-VERIFIED].
Post-chain-revision, modern electronics, depreciated early-mid values - the sweet spot for daily ownership. £2,800-£4,500 recon cost against £7,000-£20,000 vehicle value [BMW-QUOTE].
Hot-vee architecture causes seal failure at 60k-100k miles - known as the "N63 nightmare." £3,000-£6,000 repair or £6,000-£10,000 replacement [BMW-QUOTE].
Typical values of £14,000-£30,000 against £2,800-£8,000 recon cost - comfortably safe across all engine variants [BMW-QUOTE].
Ageing host values (£2,500-£7,500) against £3,200-£5,500 recon cost - the 70% BMW threshold risk [BMW-QUOTE].
B57/B58 reliability, 650L boot, 7-seat option, and strong specialist network - values justify replacement across the board.
The bulletproof naturally-aspirated straight-six - maintenance is an investment, not an expense. One of the most dependable BMWs ever built.

bottomCta.title: Honest, Data-Backed, Unbiased.
bottomCta.text: We tell you the truth - even when it means walking away. That's the Engine Finders promise.
